title: Automate Your Meeting Notes
description: Build a repeatable workflow that turns raw meeting transcripts or notes into clean, structured summaries with action items.
steps: Take raw notes from your next real meeting (bullet scrawl, transcript, or recording-to-text)
Paste them into Claude with this prompt: "Convert these raw notes into: 1) Context (1 sentence), 2) Key decisions (bullets), 3) Action items (Owner: Task by Date), 4) Open questions"
Refine the output — add any context the AI missed, remove anything incorrect
Save that prompt as a Custom GPT instruction or a reusable template
Use it for 3 consecutive meetings and measure how much time it saves
expectedOutput: A reusable meeting notes template prompt and 3 formatted meeting summaries ready to share.
bonusChallenges: Automate the workflow with Zapier: transcript arrives → AI formats → pushed to Notion
Ask the AI to also suggest what to discuss in the NEXT meeting based on current open questions
